concrete_capability_transition: Brownie CLI moves from source-tree-oriented runtime invocation to a verified installed-CLI Golden Journey: an ordinary git repository can run brownie run "<objective>" through the existing Rust brownie-runtime authority and reach terminal accepted and finalized completion without VSIX involvement, raw ledger inspection, or CLI-owned agent-loop policy.

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Proves the primary CLI command can be installed with its runtime sibling and complete a general objective from an ordinary repository using runtime-owned journey admission, completion acceptance, and completion finalization.
Relies on the existing runtime-owned agent loop to drive completion evidence, acceptance, and finalization while keeping the CLI output bounded and policy-free.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development by making brownie run executable as an installed CLI in arbitrary repositories while retaining Rust runtime authority.
answers.new_capability: A caller can stage or install brownie plus brownie-runtime into a local prefix, enter a normal git repository, run brownie run "<objective>", and receive bounded accepted/finalized completion output in human and JSON modes.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: CLI-4 through CLI-8 proved parser, transport, resume, progress, JSON, exit code, help, and installer pieces separately, but did not prove installed arbitrary-repository execution reaches runtime-owned accepted completion.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: CLI product completion would still be based on source-tree smoke tests and fake-runtime request-shape tests rather than the standalone primary command working in an ordinary repository.
answers.non_duplicative: CLI-6 rendered progress, CLI-7 stabilized public output and exit classes, and CLI-8 added help/install. CLI-9 validates end-to-end installed execution and runtime-owned acceptance/finalization outside the Brownie source tree.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The implementation uses existing headless.run.drive and task.run completion acceptance/finalization routes rather than adding a new runtime RPC or passthrough.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. No report, readiness, digest, verdict, history, or inspection surface is added.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime behavior changes narrowly so omitted-mode headless journey admission selects a runtime-owned provider-runner default for general CLI objectives and completion/finalization treats no-eligible terminal routes as closed rather than as pending explicit work.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: External callers can trust brownie run from non-Brownie repositories before restart/recovery work, including bounded completion projection and fail-closed runtime error behavior.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes the CLI-9 arbitrary-repository Golden Journey gap and leaves CLI-10 restart/recovery as the final required CLI Product DoD gap before CLI product completion assessment.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: CLI-9 updates executable CLI/runtime behavior and current phase manifest only; review must confirm no guard weakening or wrapper-only surface is introduced.

exit_criteria: A temporary-prefix installed brownie executable resolves a sibling brownie-runtime binary without BROWNIE_RUNTIME_PATH.
From a temporary ordinary git repository outside the Brownie source tree, brownie run "<objective>" reaches runtime-owned complete closure, AcceptedComplete, and finalized completion output.
--json run "<objective>" from an independent ordinary git repository returns the stable public CLI projection with complete closure, AcceptedComplete, finalized status, and bounded fingerprints.
The CLI follows existing runtime-owned completion acceptance/finalization routes using bounded task/run/fingerprint/session metadata instead of inspecting ledgers or inventing completion policy.
Omitted-mode headless journey admission remains Rust-runtime-owned and does not make the CLI choose Mode Pack or permission policy.
No new runtime RPC, generic passthrough, report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, summary, CLI-owned policy engine, or workspace mutation authority is introduced.
Output does not expose raw prompt, provider response, raw file content, stdout, stderr, command string, environment values, absolute paths, canonical paths, tokens, or secrets.
behavior_evidence: brownie-cli fake-runtime tests prove complete closure is followed by runtime-owned task.run acceptance, accepted route inspection, and authorized finalization with sequence/fingerprint validation.
brownie-cli installed-run test stages brownie and brownie-runtime into a temporary prefix and completes human output from an ordinary git repository without runtime path environment configuration.
brownie-cli installed-json-run test stages the same sibling binaries and verifies stable public JSON completion projection from a separate ordinary git repository.
brownie-runtime test proves omitted-mode journey admission creates a provider-runner task under runtime authority and avoids subtask orchestration.
brownie-runtime completion/finalization guards treat no-eligible terminal routes consistently as completion-safe when terminal evidence and all-known-task completion hold.

accepted_capability: The installed Brownie CLI can run a general objective from an ordinary repository through the sibling Rust runtime and reach accepted/finalized completion.
Human and JSON CLI projections expose bounded completion status without raw runtime envelopes or sensitive path/environment leakage.
behavior_evidence: Focused real-runtime arbitrary-repository tests pass for human and JSON mode.
Focused runtime test passes for omitted-mode runtime-owned provider-runner journey admission.
Focused fake-runtime acceptance/finalization test passes for request choreography and projection.
safety_boundary: No Core Runtime terminal campaign state is reopened or mutated.
No new runtime JSON-RPC method is added.
The CLI does not read ledgers, discover Mode Packs from files, evaluate permissions, select tasks, apply patches, or own recovery policy.
The runtime remains the authority for mode resolution, task execution, completion acceptance, finalization, replay, and persistence.
non_goals: No restart/lost-response recovery Golden Journey closure.
No Homebrew formula, npm publication, signed release artifacts, notarization, or global package publication.
No Mode Pack, Product DoD, provider, permission, workspace mutation, replay, or fail-closed semantic redesign.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected CLI-owned default mode selection because omitted-mode behavior must remain Rust-runtime-owned.
Rejected treating routed explicit parent-join recursion as a CLI completion success because that would fake terminal accepted completion.
Rejected direct ledger inspection by CLI because completion evidence must travel through bounded runtime-owned RPC results.
Rejected fake-runtime-only completion evidence because CLI-9 specifically requires arbitrary-repository installed execution.
technical_debt: CLI-10 must validate restart/recovery including scoped resume and runtime-owned recovery provenance.
A future nonblocking runtime improvement may scope accepted-completion lookup to the active journey owner when multiple completed CLI sessions share a repository.
next_capability_rationale: After CLI-9 lands, proceed to CLI-10 Restart / Recovery Golden Journey rather than adding more installed-run variants.
